title: Klaus Fuchs atomic espionage

tellings.quote: that like the next Klaus Fuchs you know the guy that like stole the American atomic secrets worked at Los Alamos from 1941 to 1950

plain: Klaus Fuchs worked at Los Alamos, which Michels dates from 1941 to 1950, and stole American atomic secrets. Michels mentions it himself in an episode with a guest named Dave Rossi, as an example of a scientist leaking secret research. He uses it to ask whether someone could become 'the next Klaus Fuchs'.
